purpose: M49.R2 regex debt register: every needs_review/replaceable regex in an analyzer; shrink-only. entries.justification: PATH SPLIT on a raw path string: the operand is text (`SCSS @import` specifier), not a node. Replaceable in principle by an indexOf walk; NOT converted in this wave because scss's split feeds a directory walk whose fixture coverage is thin (3 fixtures) - converting it without moving the fixture summary would be an unproven equivalence. entries.justification: RAW-TEXT MICRO-PARSE (policy rung 3): the input is the whole YAML document as TEXT and the question is which line carries the resource identity. There is no AST node that answers it - the analyzer is deliberately re-reading raw text here because the node the grammar gives is the document, not the identity line. The capture group is a `[A-Za-z]`-led token with three optional quote/space tolerances; a char scan would re-implement the same grammar. Registered, audited, retained.
